data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian. The company has raised $48M to date. The peer universe consists of 9 comparable companies across AI & Software—1 public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms including Reflection AI, Scale AI, Waymo, and Figure AI, spanning Series A through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($48M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis across four directly comparable companies (Scale AI at $29.0B, Reflection AI at $25.0B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, and Black Forest Labs at $3.2B) yields a median valuation of $15.3B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $29.0B.

Triangulating these two approaches produces a wide valuation range: low-end $82M, median $7.7B, and high-end $17.6B. The substantial dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding whether Archetype AI's future stage progression will track toward later-stage comparable valuations or remain closer to its current fundraising metrics. Stage and revenue trajectory, competitive positioning within the AI software sector, and investor appetite for frontier-tech funding rounds represent key variables that will materially inform a refined valuation.
